authority_observations.claim: IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BIG_ENDIAN) selects setting or clearing HC_CONTROL_DATA_BIG_ENDIAN in HC_CONTROL; changed mode is read back and unsupported mode returns -EOPNOTSUPP.

Endianness choice explicitly concerns CPU data accesses, default CPU_LITTLE_ENDIAN; CPU_BIG_ENDIAN is a bool big-endian kernel choice with linker constraint. This is ARM64 source semantics only, not actual selected config.

Root ARM Kconfig sources arch/arm/mm/Kconfig; full-tree declaration query locates CPU_BIG_ENDIAN at that child line740. Child body was not saved; do not infer full ARM semantics or actual parsed route.

The saved same-revision declaration query reports 15 CPU_BIG_ENDIAN matches and no BIG_ENDIAN match; exact regex requires column-zero (menu)config and exact name. It is not full Kconfig parsing or generated-config proof.

Tracked-tree direct object-like #define query for CONFIG_BIG_ENDIAN/CONFIG_CPU_BIG_ENDIAN has empty output and exit1, empty stderr. This does not exclude generated autoconf, command-line -D, external definitions or nonmatching spelling forms.

conditional_mechanism.secondary_dimension: P4 mode negotiation may be relevant but no independent capability fault established
conditional_mechanism.candidate_check: When a configuration predicate controls external data-order mode, bind its source declaration and documented CPU property to the controlled operation; missing/unverified source becomes review candidate, not unconditional runtime fault. Successful local mode negotiation should match the actual required host-data order, subject to register semantics and reachability evidence.
conditional_mechanism.existing_protection: Write and read-back mode validation already exists in the driver; this guards controller acceptance but does not by itself prove the requested mode was derived from the correct CPU property.

minimum_next_experiment_gate: Freeze finite same-parent evidence request for IS_ENABLED definition and relevant generated-config semantics before making an execution claim; actual Kconfig/config and driver build-reach remain separate.
Obtain same-version data-order register contract and actual consumer/data path, or explicitly model bit semantics as assumptions; source names/comments alone do not prove DMA/PIO payload effect.

If only local projection is feasible, freeze source slice, CPU endian value, initial control bit, writable/read-back behavior and expected result before running; pair BE/LE and accepted/rejected writes plus unrelated-bit preservation.
Compare original predicate, proposed correct-property predicate, and normal/no-change inputs; no-run paths are unassessed, mode-read-back failure should be error, not successful setup.
